title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%. Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 80.8% (sc:70210@2026Q3).

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, I checked your numbers and you make fair points about the material index and our delivery last quarter. I can drop the price to 31.00 EUR for 35 days lead time to beat that other offer, but we must keep payment at 30 days. We need the cash flowing to keep the shop running smoothly for you.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and rival quote and delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

Thank you for your quick revision and for checking our data so carefully. Your previous scorecard records 1997 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q2).

At our supplier day you described Hollerau as an important reference customer. With the HX series you would have 4200 pc per year over 24 months, which uses the free capacity you mentioned. Please find two complete packages attached. The second shortens our payment to 14 days to support your cash flow.

Which of the two suits your shop better? What is the earliest lead time you can confirm for the first call-offs in March 2027?

We look forward to your reply.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We have already taken that quality record data into account. 

Hallo, the 14 days payment option is great for our cash flow, so I will build on that package. I can come down to 28.50 EUR per unit for 14 days payment and 35 days lead time. So, our offer is a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? You mentioned 4200 pieces per year, please send over the binding forecast so I can lock in the capacity and confirm the March lead time. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – complete packages
messages.body:
Hallo Frau Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your quote for the HX pump shaft.

Our should-cost estimate for part:320070 is EUR 36.87 per unit (cost:320070), below your price. A valid competing offer is EUR 28.5 per unit (offer:70210-2); please improve your complete package. We read that Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03); our volume fills capacity you have free, and we expect that to show in your price.

Two complete packages are attached. The second shortens our payment term, as you asked in your e-mail on payment of invoices, to support your cash flow. Which suits you better, and what is the earliest lead time you can confirm for the March 2027 start?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
